gloss: to roast; to broil; to toast over flame

forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {炙|あぶ}っていませんでした

definitions.gloss: to roast; to broil; to toast over flame
definitions.explanation: To cook food by exposing it directly to heat or flame, often to lightly sear or warm the surface.
To hold something near a fire or heat source to warm it.

examples.japanese: ⟦{海苔|のり}→海苔：10391_nori⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{炙|あぶ}って⟦{食|た}べる→食べる：00396_taberu⟧。
examples.english: I toast the seaweed and eat it.
Dried squid smells great when toasted.

examples.japanese: ⟦{寿司|すし}→寿司：04946_sushi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦サーモン→サーモン：08836_saamon⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{軽|かる}く→軽い：00785_karui⟧{炙|あぶ}って⟦もらった→もらう：00520_morau⟧。
examples.english: I had the salmon on my sushi lightly seared.
I warmed my hands by the fire.

examples.japanese: ⟦{寒|さむ}くて→寒い：00664_samui⟧⟦{体|からだ}→体：00784_karada⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦ストーブ→ストーブ：02906_sutoobu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{炙|あぶ}って⟦いた→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: It was cold, so I was warming myself by the stove.

examples.japanese: たき{火|び}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{足|あし}→足：00575_ashi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{炙|あぶ}り⟦ながら→ながら：10530_nagara⟧⟦{話|はな}した→話す：00467_hanasu⟧。
examples.english: We talked while warming our feet by the bonfire.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY:
- ⟦{他動詞|たどうし}→他動詞：10418_tadoushi⟧ (transitive): takes ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ for the thing being heated. No intransitive pair.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{海苔|のり}→海苔：10391_nori⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{炙|あぶ}る: to toast seaweed
- ⟦{軽|かる}く→軽い：00785_karui⟧{炙|あぶ}る: to sear lightly
- ⟦{火|ひ}→火：02248_hi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{炙|あぶ}る: to toast over a flame
- ⟦{手|て}→手：00569_te⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{炙|あぶ}る: to warm one's hands at a fire

COMPOUNDS:
- {炙|あぶ}り{焼|や}き: flame-searing
- {炙|あぶ}り{寿司|ずし}: seared sushi

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{焼|や}く→焼く：01123_yaku⟧: the general word for cooking with heat (grilling, baking, frying). {炙|あぶ}る is brief, direct exposure to flame, usually just the surface.

WRITING:
- Also written {焙|あぶ}る; in kana, あぶる.
